<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 5"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Alarming Disappearance](/Feats.aspx?ID=5369) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Minotaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=788" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 43

**Prerequisites**
Expert in [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48)

</column>

---

Your ability to move unseen is startling for one your size, causing panic among your enemies. When you successfully [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) when previously [observed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=84), creatures you are [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=79) from become [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76). They are then temporarily immune to Alarming Disappearance for 1 hour.
name: Alarming Disappearance
